spec: C05-BUILD-SPEC.md 交付物 8 (Windows 路径变体 /./ ) — KNOWN-PROBLEMS.md P8/E7
description: file_path spelled with a redundant /./ segment immediately before the leaf filename (e.g. .../memory/./decisions.md). Only the shadow hook is a relevant consumer -- pmm-index-emit.cjs never receives a single file path, only a --dir. Expect: a shadow log line is appended for the event (never silent -- no line would mean the event was dropped before appendShadowLine), and isMemory resolves true (correct judgment) despite the non-canonical spelling, proving core.matchCanonical()'s path.win32.normalize()-based pipeline collapses the /./ segment correctly. Empirically confirmed via isolated probe before committing this fixture.
